info.title: Ranjit API
info.description: Self-hosted financial data API with a local sandbox and direct Efí / Inter Empresas adapters. Bank account access requires credentials issued to the operator; coverage depends on the provider.

localSession.name: ranjit_session
localSession.description: Embedded localhost dashboard only. Mutations require a matching Origin. Sessions last 8 hours and are lost on restart.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: next_cursor from the preceding page, using the same filters.

sandbox.description: True for simulated or bank test environments.

data_coverage.description: Coverage of the configured adapter. Inter exposes available balance and account statement; Efí exposes balance, received Pix and completed refunds.

consent_expires_at.description: Local collection deadline. For api_credentials this is not a consent registered at the bank. Omitted for file imports, which do not expire. Pausing or expiration stops direct collection while keeping personal history readable.

customer_id.description: Opaque application customer ID. The server enforces a 128-byte UTF-8 limit.

authorization_url.description: Present only for the local sandbox consent flow.

amount_minor.description: Signed centavos. Negative amounts are debits.

balance_at.description: Bank read observation time or OFX ledger date; omitted when unknown.

requests_completed.description: Successful bank GET responses saved for this job, including balance and statement pages.

Error410.description: Authorization is invalid, expired or already used

Error502.description: Provider credentials or scope are invalid, or the provider is unavailable.
